title: Cumulative units sold by category, through each 2025 month
prompt: Merchandising wants each category's cumulative units sold as of each month in 2025 (all-time cumulative, not reset each year). What stages of granularity get you there?
population: Order_items on all completed orders (all-time, so the cumulative total is correct), joined to products for category.
grain: order_item → category × month units → category running total (window) → final: category × month for 2025 months.
metricDefinition: cumulative sum(quantity) per category, through each month, restricted to 2025 months in the output.
transformationPlan: aggregate order_items to category × month units (completed orders, all-time)
compute each category's running total across months (window function)
keep only 2025 months in the final output
referenceSql: WITH category_month AS (SELECT p.category, date_trunc('month', o.order_date) AS month, sum(oi.quantity) AS units FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.category, date_trunc('month', o.order_date)), running AS (SELECT category, month, sum(units) OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY month) AS cumulative_units FROM category_month) SELECT category, month, cumulative_units FROM running WHERE month >= DATE '2025-01-01' ORDER BY category, month
